description:
These exclusive Marbella apartments and penthouses form part of a brand new development in Los Monteros.  With just 39 units this luxury development offers 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartments and duplex penthouses with fantastic terraces and incredible sea views. Situated in Altos de Los Monteros this brand new development is situated on an elevated plot on the east side of Marbella. A 30 minute-drive will lead you to the Malaga International Airport, allowing you to enjoy your property, even for short stays.

This beautiful new Marbella development has been designed as a concept of a Boutique residential complex offering resort style living. A fabulous place where the greens meet the blues: nature, sea and the horizon. Your new 5-star life is endorsed by magnificent leisure and wellness services, excellent qualities and views of the sea so that your life is always surrounded by nature with a marked healthy lifestyle.

Contemporary styled buildings, large terraces along with a select range of top quality materials define the personality of this collection of homes designed for you to enjoy the very best lifestyle on the Costa del Sol. These contemporary Marbella apartment are located just far enough away from the town centre, yet within minutes you could be soaking up the sunshine on the fabulous beaches or enjoying a sumptuous al fresco lunch in Marbella’s old town.

The design and orientation of these fantastic Marbella apartments ensures maximum natural light. An innovative project comprising of just 39 spacious environmentally friendly units, fantastic communal areas with an outdoor pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, a co-working space as well as an indoor heated pool and a spa.

If you would like to live in a contemporary Marbella apartment on the Costa del Sol, call us today for more information.
